## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the standard error of a Sharpe ratio and the autocorrelation correction from memory.
- Report a performance result out loud in the form you will use all year: estimate, interval, sample size, convention.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, seventh sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, then 1.05 to the 12th power to two decimal places, approximated in your head.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Order statistics, a first look: draw three independent uniforms on the unit interval. What is the expected value of the largest? Of the middle one? Get the general formula for the kth of n and say out loud why the answers are equally spaced.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The trading-flavoured version they actually ask: two people each draw a uniform on the unit interval, see only their own, and may swap once if both agree. Should you ever agree to swap? Explain the adverse selection in two sentences.
:::
:::
